knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=A DESeqDataSet object containing raw counts and metadata ;; method=The classification algorithm to use (e.g., "svmRadial", "voomNSC", "PLDA") ;; preProcessing=Normalization-transformation combination for continuous classifiers (e.g., "deseq-vst", "deseq-rlog") ;; normalize=Normalization method for discrete/voom-based classifiers (e.g., "deseq", "TMM") ;; ref=The reference class label (e.g., "T") ;; control=Control list for model building, defined using trainControl(), discreteControl(), or voomControl() ;; tuneLength=Number of levels for tuning parameters
- alternatives: Microarray-based classifiers (e.g., svmRadial, pam, rpart via caret) vs. discrete-based classifiers (PLDA, NBLDA) vs. voom-based classifiers (voomNSC, voomDLDA, voomDQDA). Use discrete or voom-based classifiers to work directly with count-based properties, or use continuous classifiers after transforming counts (vst, rlog, log-cpm) to continuous scale.
- when_to_use: When performing classification, biomarker discovery, or feature importance ranking on high-throughput RNA-Seq raw count data.
- pitfalls: Input counts must be raw sequencing read counts, not pre-normalized or pre-transformed values. The preProcessing argument is only valid for continuous classifiers, whereas normalize must be used for discrete and voom-based classifiers. When updating an MLSeq object using update(), the control list must be compatible with the new classifier type (e.g., trainControl for continuous, discreteControl for discrete, voomControl for voom-based) to avoid errors. The update() function does not overwrite the object in place; the output must be explicitly reassigned.

workflows.name: rna_seq_classification
workflows.intent: Preprocess raw RNA-Seq count data, train a machine learning classifier (continuous, discrete, or voom-based) with parameter tuning, and predict class labels for test samples.
workflows.stages: 1. Load raw count data and define class labels ;; 2. Split data into training and test sets ;; 3. Create DESeqDataSet objects for training and testing ;; 4. Define control parameters using trainControl, discreteControl, or voomControl ;; 5. Train the classifier using classify ;; 6. Predict class labels of test samples using predict ;; 7. Evaluate model performance using confusionMatrix ;; 8. Extract selected biomarkers using selectedGenes (for sparse classifiers) ;; 9. Modify and update the trained model using update
workflows.code:
filepath <- system.file("extdata/cervical.txt", package = "MLSeq")
cervical <- read.table(filepath, header=TRUE)
class <- DataFrame(condition = factor(rep(c("N","T"), c(29, 29))))
vars <- sort(apply(cervical, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE)
data <- cervical[names(vars)[1:100], ]
nTest <- ceiling(ncol(data) * 0.3)
ind <- sample(ncol(data), nTest, FALSE)
data.train <- as.matrix(data[ ,-ind] + 1)
data.test <- as.matrix(data[ ,ind] + 1)
classtr <- DataFrame(condition = class[-ind, ])
classts <- DataFrame(condition = class[ind, ])
data.trainS4 = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = data.train, colData = classtr, design = formula(~condition))
data.testS4 = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = data.test, colData = classts, design = formula(~condition))
fit.svm <- classify(data = data.trainS4, method = "svmRadial", preProcessing = "deseq-vst", ref = "T", tuneLength = 10, control = trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 10, classProbs = TRUE))
ctrl.plda <- discreteControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 1, tuneLength = 10)
fit.plda <- classify(data = data.trainS4, method = "PLDA", normalize = "deseq", ref = "T", control = ctrl.plda)
ctrl.voomDLDA <- voomControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 1, tuneLength = 10)
fit.voomDLDA <- classify(data = data.trainS4, method = "voomDLDA", normalize = "deseq", ref = "T", control = ctrl.voomDLDA)
pred.svm <- predict(fit.svm, data.testS4)
pred.svm <- relevel(pred.svm, ref = "T")
actual <- relevel(classts$condition, ref = "T")
tbl <- table(Predicted = pred.svm, Actual = actual)
confusionMatrix(tbl, positive = "T")
selectedGenes(fit.voomNSC)
method(fit) <- "PLDA2"
ref(fit) <- "N"
normalization(fit) <- "TMM"
fit <- update(fit)
control(fit) <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 5, repeats = 2)
preProcessing(fit) <- "tmm-logcpm"
fit <- update(fit)
